maddeler.e:
اشتهين (form VIII)
# اِشْتَهَيْنَ (ištahayna) /iʃ.ta.haj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اُشْتُهِينَ (uštuhīna) /uʃ.tu.hiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اِشْتَهِينَ (ištahīna) /iʃ.ta.hiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
